Alertas/Bugs (o que identifiquei só do ZIP)

  1. ctx.yml inválido (YAMLException)
    Está mal indentado e com linhas “coladas” (o ZIP traz os erros em data-summary.json). Corrigir esse manifesto pra seu pipeline não falhar.

  2. Divergência SQLite vs Postgres

    • package.json usa C:\sqlite\sqlite3.exe em db:migrate/db:seed (Windows/SQLite).

    • O snapshot do banco é Postgres (com funções, triggers, índices).
      ✅ É possível dev=SQLite / prod=PG, mas hoje as migrations/seeds não estão unificadas. Risco de “drift” entre ambientes.

  3. Tabelas críticas vazias (class_skill_rates, skill_curves, weapon_skill_map)
    Se o treino/combate lê essas curvas/rates, o sistema pode não evoluir skill nenhum ou lançar erro em runtime. Precisa seed imediato.

  4. Catálogos mínimos
    sprites_master: 2, items_master: 2. UIs que dependem disso podem aparecer vazias/estranhas.

  5. Conteúdo de mapas raso
    maps: 1, spawns: 3, map_objects: 1. O admin existe, mas o volume sugere estágio inicial. Garanta fallbacks no client.

  6. Padronização de erros
    error-map.json mostra respostas {error: err.message} e {error: e.message} misturadas. Padronize ({ ok:false, message, code }).

  7. Rotas genéricas (/list, /select, /state, /status)
    Nome pouco descritivo. Renomear pra algo com domínio (ex. /players/select-team, /system/status) evita colisões futuras.

  8. Script save não existe neste package.json
    No ZIP atual não há save. Se você digitou save no PowerShell e esperava zip/backup/release, é por isso que “não aconteceu nada”.

1) Seeds e DDL (100% Postgres)

Crie um arquivo em server/db/seeds/010_skills_seed.pg.sql com todo o conteúdo abaixo.
Ele é idempotente (pode rodar várias vezes, usa ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE).

sql
-- 010_skills_seed.pg.sql
-- Alinha as 3 tabelas base + índices únicos + popula CURVAS/RATES/MAPAS de skill.
-- Seguro rodar várias vezes (idempotente).

-- 1) Tabelas (com IF NOT EXISTS; se já existirem, não mexe)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS skill_curves (
  skill_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  level      INTEGER NOT NULL,
  tries_needed INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (skill_type, level)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS class_skill_rates (
  class      TEXT NOT NULL,
  skill_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  rate       NUMERIC(6,3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,
  PRIMARY KEY (class, skill_type)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS weapon_skill_map (
  weapon_type TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  skill_type  TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- 2) Índices extras (se já existirem, pula)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_skill_curves_skill ON skill_curves (skill_type, level);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_class_skill_rates_class ON class_skill_rates (class, skill_type);

-- 3) CURVAS DE SKILL (tries_needed por nível)
-- Fórmula suave-exponencial: base 8 * 1.175^(level-1) (ajustável depois via balance.json)
-- Gera níveis 1..120 para todas as SKILLS: SWORD, AXE, CLUB, DISTANCE, SHIELD, MAGIC

WITH levels AS (
  SELECT generate_series(1, 120) AS lvl
)
INSERT INTO skill_curves (skill_type, level, tries_needed)
SELECT s.skill_type, l.lvl,
       CEIL(8 * POWER(1.175, l.lvl - 1))::int AS tries_needed
FROM (VALUES
  ('SWORD'),('AXE'),('CLUB'),('DISTANCE'),('SHIELD'),('MAGIC')
) AS s(skill_type)
CROSS JOIN levels l
ON CONFLICT (skill_type, level) DO UPDATE
SET tries_needed = EXCLUDED.tries_needed
WHERE skill_curves.tries_needed IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.tries_needed;

-- 4) RATES POR CLASSE (multiplicadores de ganho de try por hit)
-- Classes baselines (ajuste à vontade depois): KNIGHT, RANGER, MAGE, GUARDIAN
-- Regra: Knight brilha em melee/shield; Ranger em distance; Mage em magic; Guardian em shield/defense.

-- Limpamos só as classes que vamos semear (sem apagar outras custom)
DELETE FROM class_skill_rates WHERE class IN ('KNIGHT','RANGER','MAGE','GUARDIAN');

-- KNIGHT
INSERT INTO class_skill_rates (class, skill_type, rate) VALUES
 ('KNIGHT','SWORD',1.200),
 ('KNIGHT','AXE',1.200),
 ('KNIGHT','CLUB',1.150),
 ('KNIGHT','DISTANCE',0.500),
 ('KNIGHT','SHIELD',1.300),
 ('KNIGHT','MAGIC',0.200)
ON CONFLICT (class, skill_type) DO UPDATE SET rate = EXCLUDED.rate;

-- RANGER
INSERT INTO class_skill_rates (class, skill_type, rate) VALUES
 ('RANGER','SWORD',0.600),
 ('RANGER','AXE',0.600),
 ('RANGER','CLUB',0.600),
 ('RANGER','DISTANCE',1.300),
 ('RANGER','SHIELD',0.800),
 ('RANGER','MAGIC',0.600)
ON CONFLICT (class, skill_type) DO UPDATE SET rate = EXCLUDED.rate;

-- MAGE
INSERT INTO class_skill_rates (class, skill_type, rate) VALUES
 ('MAGE','SWORD',0.300),
 ('MAGE','AXE',0.300),
 ('MAGE','CLUB',0.500),
 ('MAGE','DISTANCE',0.700),
 ('MAGE','SHIELD',0.500),
 ('MAGE','MAGIC',1.400)
ON CONFLICT (class, skill_type) DO UPDATE SET rate = EXCLUDED.rate;

-- GUARDIAN (tank/defesa)
INSERT INTO class_skill_rates (class, skill_type, rate) VALUES
 ('GUARDIAN','SWORD',1.000),
 ('GUARDIAN','AXE',0.900),
 ('GUARDIAN','CLUB',0.900),
 ('GUARDIAN','DISTANCE',0.500),
 ('GUARDIAN','SHIELD',1.500),
 ('GUARDIAN','MAGIC',0.400)
ON CONFLICT (class, skill_type) DO UPDATE SET rate = EXCLUDED.rate;

-- 5) MAPA: arma -> skill (compatível Tibia-like)
-- Observação: "staff" no Tibia é CLUB; "wand/rod" é MAGIC; spear/bow/crossbow = DISTANCE.
-- Limpamos tipos que vamos semear para evitar duplicata.
DELETE FROM weapon_skill_map WHERE weapon_type IN (
 'sword','longsword','rapier','sabre','dagger',
 'axe','battleaxe','hatchet',
 'club','mace','hammer','staff',
 'bow','crossbow','spear','javelin','throwing_knife',
 'wand','rod','tome','shield'
);

INSERT INTO weapon_skill_map (weapon_type, skill_type) VALUES
 -- SWORD
 ('sword','SWORD'), ('longsword','SWORD'), ('rapier','SWORD'), ('sabre','SWORD'), ('dagger','SWORD'),
 -- AXE
 ('axe','AXE'), ('battleaxe','AXE'), ('hatchet','AXE'),
 -- CLUB
 ('club','CLUB'), ('mace','CLUB'), ('hammer','CLUB'), ('staff','CLUB'),
 -- DISTANCE

2) Runner em Node para executar SQLs (sem precisar psql)

Crie server/scripts/pg-run-sql.js:

js
// server/scripts/pg-run-sql.js
// Uso: node server/scripts/pg-run-sql.js server/db/seeds/010_skills_seed.pg.sql
//      node server/scripts/pg-run-sql.js server/db/seeds   (executa todos .sql em ordem)

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { Pool } = require('pg');

if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) {
  console.error('❌ DATABASE_URL não definido no ambiente.');
  process.exit(1);
}

const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL, max: 2 });

async function runFile(file) {
  const sql = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
  console.log(`\n▶ Executando ${file}`);
  await pool.query(sql);
  console.log(`✔ OK ${path.basename(file)}`);
}

(async () => {
  try {
    const target = process.argv[2];
    if (!target) {
      console.error('Uso: node server/scripts/pg-run-sql.js <arquivo.sql | pasta>');
      process.exit(1);
    }

    const stat = fs.statSync(target);
    if (stat.isDirectory()) {
      const files = fs.readdirSync(target)
        .filter(f => f.toLowerCase().endsWith('.sql'))
        .sort((a,b) => a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { numeric: true }))
        .map(f => path.join(target, f));
      for (const file of files) await runFile(file);
    } else {
      await runFile(target);
    }
    await pool.end();
    console.log('\n✅ Concluído.');
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('❌ Erro:', e.message);
    process.exit(1);
  }
})();

4) Serviço de ganho de skill por hit (integração leve, sem quebrar nada)

Crie server/skills/service.js:

js
// server/skills/service.js
// Funções para: resolver classe do herói, mapear arma->skill, aplicar try e upar nível.

const { Pool } = require('pg');
const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL });

/** Obtém { class, hero_key } do herói. Ajuste esta query aos seus campos reais. */
async function getHeroMeta(heroId) {
  // Tente primeiro player_heroes -> heroes_master (ajuste colunas se necessário)
  const sql = `
    SELECT ph.id AS hero_id,
           COALESCE(ph.class, hm.class) AS class,
           ph.hero_key
    FROM player_heroes ph
    LEFT JOIN heroes_master hm ON hm.hero_key = ph.hero_key
    WHERE ph.id = $1
    LIMIT 1
  `;
  const { rows } = await pool.query(sql, [heroId]);
  return rows[0] || null;
}

/** weapon_type -> skill_type (usa seed weapon_skill_map) */
async function resolveSkillTypeFromWeapon(weaponType) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT skill_type FROM weapon_skill_map WHERE weapon_type = $1 LIMIT 1`,
    [weaponType]
  );
  return rows[0]?.skill_type || null;
}

/** rate por classe/skill (default 1.0 se não achar) */
async function getClassRate(_class, skillType) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT rate FROM class_skill_rates WHERE class = $1 AND skill_type = $2 LIMIT 1`,
    [_class, skillType]
  );
  return rows[0]?.rate ?? 1.0;
}

/** Busca/Cria linha de skill do herói (level/tries) */
async function getOrCreateHeroSkill(client, heroId, skillType) {
  // Tente selecionar
  let { rows } = await client.query(
    `SELECT hero_id, skill_type, level, tries FROM player_hero_skills
     WHERE hero_id = $1 AND skill_type = $2 LIMIT 1`,
    [heroId, skillType]
  );
  if (rows[0]) return rows[0];

  // Se não existe, cria no nível 1 com 0 tries
  await client.query(
    `INSERT INTO player_hero_skills (hero_id, skill_type, level, tries)
     VALUES ($1, $2, 1, 0)
     ON CONFLICT (hero_id, skill_type) DO NOTHING`,
    [heroId, skillType]
  );
  ({ rows } = await client.query(
    `SELECT hero_id, skill_type, level, tries FROM player_hero_skills
     WHERE hero_id = $1 AND skill_type = $2 LIMIT 1`,
    [heroId, skillType]
  ));
  return rows[0];
}

/** tries_needed para próximo nível */
async function getTriesNeeded(skillType, nextLevel) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT tries_needed FROM skill_curves WHERE skill_type = $1 AND level = $2 LIMIT 1`,
    [skillType, nextLevel]
  );
  // fallback defensivo (não deveria ocorrer se seedou certinho)
  return rows[0]?.tries_needed ?? 999999;
}

/** Aplica 1 "try" (ou um delta) e faz carry para níveis seguintes se necessário */
async function gainSkillTry(heroId, weaponType, opts = {}) {
  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    const hero = await getHeroMeta(heroId);
    if (!hero) throw new Error('Hero not found');

    const skillType = await resolveSkillTypeFromWeapon(weaponType);
    if (!skillType) {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      return { ok: false, message: `No skill for weaponType=${weaponType}` };
    }

    const rate = await getClassRate(hero.class || 'KNIGHT', skillType);
    const delta = Math.max(1, Math.round((opts.baseTry || 1) * rate));

    // pega/gera a linha do herói
    let phs = await getOrCreateHeroSkill(client, heroId, skillType);

    let currLevel = phs.level;
    let currTries = phs.tries + delta;

    // sobe níveis enquanto tiver tries suficientes
    while (true) {
      const triesNeeded = await getTriesNeeded(skillType, currLevel + 1);
      if (currTries >= triesNeeded) {
        currLevel += 1;
        currTries -= triesNeeded;
      } else {
        break;
      }
    }

    await client.query(
      `UPDATE player_hero_skills
         SET level = $3, tries = $4
       WHERE hero_id = $1 AND skill_type = $2`,
      [heroId, skillType, currLevel, currTries]
    );

    await client.query('COMMIT');
    return { ok: true, heroId, skillType, level: currLevel, tries: currTries, rate };
  } catch (e) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    return { ok: false, message: e.message };
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

module.exports = {
  gainSkillTry
};

Observações de compatibilidade

  • Se seus nomes de colunas/tabelas diferirem, ajuste as queries (comentei onde).

  • player_hero_skills precisa ter (hero_id, skill_type) UNIQUE. Se não tiver, crie índice único.

(Opcional) índice único de segurança:

sql
-- Rode uma vez no seu banco se ainda não existir:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_player_hero_skills ON player_hero_skills (hero_id, skill_type);

5) Serviço de dano simples + gatilho de ganho de skill

Crie server/combat/service.js:

js
// server/combat/service.js
// Dano simplificado e integração com gainSkillTry (1 try por hit bem-sucedido).
const { Pool } = require('pg');
const { gainSkillTry } = require('../skills/service');
const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL });

/** Obtém stats básicos do herói. Ajuste conforme seu schema. */
async function getHeroStats(heroId) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT ph.id AS hero_id,
            COALESCE(ph.attack, 10) AS attack,
            COALESCE(ph.defense, 10) AS defense,
            COALESCE(ph.power, 1)   AS power
     FROM player_heroes ph
     WHERE ph.id = $1
     LIMIT 1`, [heroId]
  );
  return rows[0] || null;
}

/** Obtém stats do monstro */
async function getMonsterStats(monsterId) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT id, name,
            COALESCE(attack, 8)  AS attack,
            COALESCE(defense, 6) AS defense,
            COALESCE(hp, 50)     AS hp
     FROM monsters_master
     WHERE id = $1
     LIMIT 1`, [monsterId]
  );
  return rows[0] || null;
}

/** Fórmula simples de dano (MVP). Ajuste depois com skills/equip/crit/resists. */
function computeDamage(baseAtk, baseDef, opts = {}) {
  const variance = opts.variance ?? 0.2; // +-20%
  const raw = Math.max(0, baseAtk - baseDef / 2);
  const roll = raw * (1 - variance + Math.random() * (2 * variance));
  return Math.max(0, Math.floor(roll));
}

/** Aplica um “hit” no servidor (debug/POC). */
async function applyHit({ attackerHeroId, targetMonsterId, weaponType }) {
  const attacker = await getHeroStats(attackerHeroId);
  const target   = await getMonsterStats(targetMonsterId);
  if (!attacker || !target) return { ok: false, message: 'Attacker or target not found' };

  const dmg = computeDamage(attacker.attack, target.defense, { variance: 0.2 });

  // Se causou dano > 0, concede 1 try (ajustado por rate de classe em gainSkillTry)
  if (dmg > 0) {
    await gainSkillTry(attackerHeroId, weaponType, { baseTry: 1 });
  }

  // (Opcional) persistir HP do monstro se você tiver instância/combate de sessão.
  return { ok: true, damage: dmg };
}

module.exports = { applyHit };

// server/routes/combat.js
const express = require('express');
const router = express.Router();
const { applyHit } = require('../combat/service');

router.post('/hit', async (req, res) => {

    const { attackerHeroId, targetMonsterId, weaponType } = req.body || {};
    if (!attackerHeroId || !targetMonsterId || !weaponType) {
      return res.status(400).json({ ok: false, message: 'attackerHeroId, targetMonsterId, weaponType são obrigatórios' });
    }
    const r = await applyHit({ attackerHeroId, targetMonsterId, weaponType });
    return res.status(r.ok ? 200 : 400).json(r);
  } catch (e) {
    return res.status(500).json({ ok: false, message: e.message });
  }
});

module.exports = router;

  • Combate desacoplado: applyHit é leve e chama gainSkillTry só quando dá dano > 0.

  • Pronto para evoluir: depois adicionamos crítica, evasão, resistências, armas equipadas, peso/oz, etc., sem refazer a base.

Curto e honesto: ainda não.
Do jeito que implementamos acima, o dano é calculado e a skill sobe, mas o HP não é persistido — não desconta da “vida” do monstro do YAML/monsters_master. Para ter HP real caindo, precisamos de instâncias de combate (HP atual por monstro spawnado), porque o YAML/monsters_master é só o template (HP máximo, stats base).

Se topa, aqui vai o caminho mínimo e seguro pra ligar isso agora:

1) Tabela de instância de monstro (PG)

sql
-- Uma vez:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS monster_instances (
  id            UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  monster_id    TEXT NOT NULL,         -- FK lógica p/ monsters_master.id (ou key)
  map_key       TEXT NOT NULL,
  spawn_id      TEXT,                   -- se quiser relacionar com /spawns
  max_hp        INTEGER NOT NULL,
  hp            INTEGER NOT NULL,
  state         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ALIVE', -- ALIVE|DEAD|DESPAWNED
  created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at    TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_monster_instances_alive ON monster_instances(state, map_key);

Como nasce?
Quando seu servidor “spawna” um monstro (lendo o YAML/DB), ele cria um monster_instances com max_hp = monsters_master.hp e hp = max_hp.

2) Ajustar o serviço de combate para instância

Troca o alvo de targetMonsterId → targetInstanceId, decrementando HP dentro da transação.

js
// server/combat/service.js (substituir applyHit)
const { Pool } = require('pg');
const { gainSkillTry } = require('../skills/service');
const { randomUUID } = require('crypto');
const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL });

async function getHeroStats(heroId) { /* igual antes */ }
function computeDamage(baseAtk, baseDef, opts={}) { /* igual antes */ }

async function getMonsterInstance(client, instanceId) {
  const { rows } = await client.query(
    `SELECT mi.id, mi.hp, mi.max_hp, mi.state,
            m.id AS monster_id, m.name, COALESCE(m.defense,6) AS defense
       FROM monster_instances mi
       JOIN monsters_master m ON m.id = mi.monster_id
      WHERE mi.id = $1
      LIMIT 1`, [instanceId]
  );
  return rows[0] || null;
}

async function applyHit({ attackerHeroId, targetInstanceId, weaponType }) {
  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    const attacker = await getHeroStats(attackerHeroId);
    const inst = await getMonsterInstance(client, targetInstanceId);
    if (!attacker || !inst) throw new Error('Attacker or monster instance not found');
    if (inst.state !== 'ALIVE') {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      return { ok:false, message:'Target not alive' };
    }

    const dmg = computeDamage(attacker.attack, inst.defense, { variance: 0.2 });

    let newHp = inst.hp;
    if (dmg > 0) {
      newHp = Math.max(0, inst.hp - dmg);
      await client.query(
        `UPDATE monster_instances
            SET hp = $2,
                state = CASE WHEN $2=0 THEN 'DEAD' ELSE state END,
                updated_at = now()
          WHERE id = $1`,
        [inst.id, newHp]
      );
      await gainSkillTry(attackerHeroId, weaponType, { baseTry: 1 });
    }

    await client.query('COMMIT');
    return {
      ok: true,
      damage: dmg,
      hpAfter: newHp,
      dead: newHp === 0,
      instanceId: inst.id
    };
  } catch (e) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    return { ok:false, message:e.message };
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

module.exports = { applyHit };

js
// server/routes/combat.js
router.post('/hit', async (req, res) => {
  const { attackerHeroId, targetInstanceId, weaponType } = req.body || {};
  if (!attackerHeroId || !targetInstanceId || !weaponType) {
    return res.status(400).json({ ok:false, message:'attackerHeroId, targetInstanceId, weaponType obrigatórios' });

  return res.status(r.ok ? 200 : 400).json(r);

4) Spawns/respawn (depois do básico)

  • Spawn: quando carregar o mapa/spawn, crie monster_instances com hp=max_hp.

  • Respawn: um job simples (setInterval/worker) procura state='DEAD' e recria a instância após respawn_sec do YAML/DB (ou marca DESPAWNED e faz uma nova ALIVE).

Resposta direta à tua pergunta

  • HP não deve ser descontado no YAML nem no monsters_master (isso é “template”).

  • O que desconta é o hp da instância em monster_instances.

  • Assim, vários monstros do mesmo tipo podem existir simultaneamente, cada um com seu HP atual, sem corromper o “dado canônico”.

Se quiser, eu te mando o hook de spawn (criando monster_instances a partir das suas tabelas de spawns) para fechar o ciclo: spawn → hit → HP cai → morte → respawn.

FASE 1 — Classes com HP/Mana por level e XP/Level-Up

1.1 SQL: curvas de XP e ganhos por classe

Crie (ou adicione em) server/db/seeds/020_progression.pg.sql:

sql
-- 020_progression.pg.sql
-- XP por nível e ganhos de HP/Mana por classe/nível (idempotente)

-- 1) Curva de XP (XP_to_next = 25 * level^2, como combinamos)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS xp_curves (
  level INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  xp_to_next INTEGER NOT NULL
);

WITH levels AS (SELECT generate_series(1, 200) AS lvl)
INSERT INTO xp_curves (level, xp_to_next)
SELECT lvl, (25 * (lvl * lvl))::int
FROM levels
ON CONFLICT (level) DO UPDATE
SET xp_to_next = EXCLUDED.xp_to_next
WHERE xp_curves.xp_to_next IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.xp_to_next;

-- 2) Tabela de ganhos por classe/nível (hp/mana)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS class_level_gains (
  class TEXT NOT NULL,
  level INTEGER NOT NULL,
  hp_gain INTEGER NOT NULL,
  mana_gain INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (class, level)
);

-- Seeds baseline (Tibia-like simplificado). Ajuste depois se quiser.
-- KNIGHT: muito HP, pouca Mana
WITH lvls AS (SELECT generate_series(2, 200) AS lvl)
INSERT INTO class_level_gains (class, level, hp_gain, mana_gain)
SELECT 'KNIGHT', lvl, 20, 3 FROM lvls
ON CONFLICT (class, level) DO UPDATE
SET hp_gain = EXCLUDED.hp_gain, mana_gain = EXCLUDED.mana_gain;

-- RANGER: HP médio, Mana média
WITH lvls AS (SELECT generate_series(2, 200) AS lvl)
INSERT INTO class_level_gains (class, level, hp_gain, mana_gain)
SELECT 'RANGER', lvl, 13, 7 FROM lvls
ON CONFLICT (class, level) DO UPDATE
SET hp_gain = EXCLUDED.hp_gain, mana_gain = EXCLUDED.mana_gain;

-- MAGE: pouca HP, muita Mana
WITH lvls AS (SELECT generate_series(2, 200) AS lvl)
INSERT INTO class_level_gains (class, level, hp_gain, mana_gain)
SELECT 'MAGE', lvl, 8, 12 FROM lvls
ON CONFLICT (class, level) DO UPDATE
SET hp_gain = EXCLUDED.hp_gain, mana_gain = EXCLUDED.mana_gain;

-- GUARDIAN: HP altíssimo, Mana baixa
WITH lvls AS (SELECT generate_series(2, 200) AS lvl)
INSERT INTO class_level_gains (class, level, hp_gain, mana_gain)
SELECT 'GUARDIAN', lvl, 24, 2 FROM lvls
ON CONFLICT (class, level) DO UPDATE
SET hp_gain = EXCLUDED.hp_gain, mana_gain = EXCLUDED.mana_gain;

-- 3) Progresso do herói (se você NÃO quer alterar player_heroes agora)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hero_progress (
  hero_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  xp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  hp_max INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 150,
  mana_max INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30,
  hp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 150,
  mana INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30,
  class TEXT,                 -- shadow da classe para cálculo rápido
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- Índice para consultas por classe (opcional)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_hero_progress_class ON hero_progress (class);

-- 4) Defaults iniciais por classe (opcionalmente cria baseline ao registrar)
-- Você pode popular hero_progress on-demand quando o herói entrar no jogo:
-- INSERT INTO hero_progress (hero_id, level, xp, hp_max, mana_max, hp, mana, class)
-- VALUES ($hero, 1, 0, base_hp, base_mana, base_hp, base_mana, class)
-- ON CONFLICT (hero_id) DO NOTHING;

Por que hero_progress separado?
Evitamos mexer no schema já existente e mantemos o estado (HP/Mana atuais) aqui. Depois dá para fundir.

1.2 Serviço: XP/Level-Up e cálculo de HP/Mana

Crie server/progression/service.js:

js
// server/progression/service.js
const { Pool } = require('pg');
const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL });

// Obtém classe do herói (ajuste as colunas conforme seu schema!)
async function getHeroClass(heroId) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT COALESCE(ph.class, hm.class) AS class
       FROM player_heroes ph
  LEFT JOIN heroes_master hm ON hm.hero_key = ph.hero_key
      WHERE ph.id = $1 LIMIT 1`,
    [heroId]
  );
  return rows[0]?.class || 'KNIGHT';
}

// Garante linha em hero_progress
async function ensureHeroProgress(heroId) {
  const _class = await getHeroClass(heroId);
  await pool.query(
    `INSERT INTO hero_progress (hero_id, class)
     VALUES ($1, $2)
     ON CONFLICT (hero_id) DO NOTHING`,
    [heroId, _class]
  );
}

// Soma ganhos HP/Mana da classe do nível 2..N
async function computeMaxStats(_class, level) {
  // Baselines de level 1 (ajuste se quiser)
  let baseHp = 150, baseMana = 30;
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT COALESCE(SUM(hp_gain),0) AS hp_sum,
            COALESCE(SUM(mana_gain),0) AS mana_sum
       FROM class_level_gains
      WHERE class = $1 AND level <= $2`,
    [_class, level]
  );
  const hpMax = baseHp + Number(rows[0].hp_sum || 0);
  const manaMax = baseMana + Number(rows[0].mana_sum || 0);
  return { hpMax, manaMax };
}

// Curva de XP -> quanto falta p/ próximo nível
async function xpToNext(level) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT xp_to_next FROM xp_curves WHERE level = $1 LIMIT 1`,
    [level]
  );
  return rows[0]?.xp_to_next || 9999999;
}

// Ganha XP e aplica level up em cascata (recalcula HP/Mana máximos)
async function addXp(heroId, amount) {
  await ensureHeroProgress(heroId);

  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    let { rows } = await client.query(
      `SELECT hero_id, level, xp, class FROM hero_progress WHERE hero_id = $1 LIMIT 1`,
      [heroId]
    );
    if (!rows[0]) throw new Error('hero_progress not found (ensure failed)');
    let { level, xp, class: _class } = rows[0];

    xp += amount;

    // level up em cascata
    while (true) {
      const need = await xpToNext(level);
      if (xp >= need) {
        xp -= need;
        level += 1;
      } else break;
    }

    // Recalcula HP/Mana máximos
    const { hpMax, manaMax } = await computeMaxStats(_class, level);

    // Se upou, cura tudo; se não, mantém atuais, mas clamp ao novo máximo
    let setAll = `
      UPDATE hero_progress
         SET level=$2, xp=$3, hp_max=$4, mana_max=$5,
             hp = LEAST(hp, $4), mana = LEAST(mana, $5),
             updated_at = now()
       WHERE hero_id=$1
    `;
    if (amount >= 0) {
      // Se houve level up, podemos curar full (claro e didático)
      setAll = `
        UPDATE hero_progress
           SET level=$2, xp=$3, hp_max=$4, mana_max=$5,
               hp = CASE WHEN $2 > level THEN $4 ELSE LEAST(hp, $4) END,
               mana = CASE WHEN $2 > level THEN $5 ELSE LEAST(mana, $5) END,
               updated_at = now()
         WHERE hero_id=$1
      `;
    }

    await client.query(setAll, [heroId, level, xp, hpMax, manaMax]);
    await client.query('COMMIT');

    return { ok: true, level, xp, hpMax, manaMax, class: _class };
  } catch (e) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    return { ok:false, message: e.message };
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

module.exports = { addXp, computeMaxStats, xpToNext, ensureHeroProgress };

Quando usar?
Ao matar um monstro (instância chega a 0 HP): dê XP ao herói/party via addXp(heroId, xpAmount).

FASE 2 — Ligando morte do mob → XP/Level-Up

2.1 Ajuste em applyHit para dar XP ao matar

No seu server/combat/service.js (versão com instância):

js
const { addXp } = require('../progression/service');

async function applyHit({ attackerHeroId, targetInstanceId, weaponType }) {
  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    const attacker = await getHeroStats(attackerHeroId);
    const inst = await getMonsterInstance(client, targetInstanceId);
    if (!attacker || !inst) throw new Error('Attacker or monster instance not found');
    if (inst.state !== 'ALIVE') {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      return { ok:false, message:'Target not alive' };
    }

    const dmg = computeDamage(attacker.attack, inst.defense, { variance: 0.2 });

    let newHp = inst.hp;
    let killed = false;

    if (dmg > 0) {
      newHp = Math.max(0, inst.hp - dmg);
      killed = newHp === 0;

      await client.query(
        `UPDATE monster_instances
            SET hp=$2, state=CASE WHEN $2=0 THEN 'DEAD' ELSE state END, updated_at=now()
          WHERE id=$1`,
        [inst.id, newHp]
      );

      await gainSkillTry(attackerHeroId, weaponType, { baseTry: 1 });
    }

    await client.query('COMMIT');

    // Fora da transação da instância, concede XP (pode ser assíncrono)
    if (killed) {
      // Defina um valor simples de XP do monstro (ajuste: pode vir de monsters_master.xp)
      const xpAmount = 25; // baseline — substitua por inst.xp do master se existir
      await addXp(attackerHeroId, xpAmount);
    }

    return { ok: true, damage: dmg, hpAfter: newHp, dead: killed, instanceId: inst.id };
  } catch (e) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    return { ok:false, message:e.message };
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

Notas:
• Idealmente, pegue xpAmount do monsters_master (coluna xp). Se não existir, adicione.
• Para party, distribua XP proporcional (futuro). Agora, foca no funcional.

3.2 Serviço de magia

Crie server/combat/spell_service.js:

js
// server/combat/spell_service.js
const { Pool } = require('pg');
const { gainSkillTry } = require('../skills/service'); // para subir MAGIC
const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL });

// Pega magic level do herói
async function getMagicLevel(heroId) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT level FROM player_hero_skills
      WHERE hero_id=$1 AND skill_type='MAGIC'`,
    [heroId]
  );
  return rows[0]?.level || 1;
}

// Lê mana atual e max do herói
async function getMana(heroId) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT mana, mana_max FROM hero_progress WHERE hero_id=$1`,
    [heroId]
  );
  if (!rows[0]) return { mana: 0, manaMax: 0 };
  return { mana: rows[0].mana, manaMax: rows[0].mana_max };
}

// Debita mana
async function spendMana(heroId, cost) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `UPDATE hero_progress
        SET mana = GREATEST(0, mana - $2), updated_at=now()
      WHERE hero_id = $1 AND mana >= $2
      RETURNING mana, mana_max`,
    [heroId, cost]
  );
  return rows[0] ? { ok: true, mana: rows[0].mana, manaMax: rows[0].mana_max } : { ok:false };
}

// Lê spell
async function getSpell(spellId) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(`SELECT * FROM spells_master WHERE id=$1`, [spellId]);
  return rows[0] || null;
}

// Checa desbloqueio por classe (opcional)
async function canUseSpell(_class, spellId) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT 1 FROM class_spells WHERE class=$1 AND spell_id=$2`,
    [_class, spellId]
  );
  return !!rows[0];
}

// Casting em instância de monstro
async function castSpellOnInstance({ casterHeroId, targetInstanceId, spellId }) {
  const spell = await getSpell(spellId);
  if (!spell) return { ok:false, message:'Spell not found' };

  // Classe e magic level
  const { rows: heroRows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT hp, hp_max, mana, mana_max, class FROM hero_progress WHERE hero_id=$1`,
    [casterHeroId]
  );
  if (!heroRows[0]) return { ok:false, message:'hero_progress not found' };
  const { class: _class } = heroRows[0];

  if (await canUseSpell(_class, spellId) === false) {
    return { ok:false, message:'spell locked for class' };
  }

  const ml = await getMagicLevel(casterHeroId);
  if (ml < spell.min_magic_level) {
    return { ok:false, message:'insufficient magic level' };
  }

  // Mana check
  const manaState = await getMana(casterHeroId);
  if (manaState.mana < spell.mana_cost) return { ok:false, message:'not enough mana' };

  // Dano mágico escalando por ML
  const dmg = Math.max(0, Math.floor(spell.base_power + (ml * spell.scaling)));

  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    // carrega instância
    const { rows: instRows } = await client.query(
      `SELECT mi.id, mi.hp, mi.max_hp, mi.state,
              m.id AS monster_id, m.name, COALESCE(m.defense,6) AS defense
         FROM monster_instances mi
         JOIN monsters_master m ON m.id = mi.monster_id
        WHERE mi.id = $1
        LIMIT 1`,
      [targetInstanceId]
    );
    const inst = instRows[0];
    if (!inst) throw new Error('Monster instance not found');
    if (inst.state !== 'ALIVE') {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      return { ok:false, message:'Target not alive' };
    }

    // debita mana
    const manaOk = await spendMana(casterHeroId, spell.mana_cost);
    if (!manaOk.ok) {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      return { ok:false, message:'not enough mana' };
    }

    // aplica dano mágico (ignora arma; futura: resistências)
    const newHp = Math.max(0, inst.hp - dmg);
    const dead = newHp === 0;
    await client.query(
      `UPDATE monster_instances
          SET hp=$2, state=CASE WHEN $2=0 THEN 'DEAD' ELSE state END, updated_at=now()
        WHERE id=$1`,
      [inst.id, newHp]
    );

    await client.query('COMMIT');

    // sobe MAGIC por cast
    await gainSkillTry(casterHeroId, 'wand', { baseTry: 1 }); // mapeado para MAGIC

    return { ok:true, damage: dmg, hpAfter: newHp, dead, instanceId: inst.id };
  } catch (e) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    return { ok:false, message:e.message };
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

module.exports = { castSpellOnInstance };

server/routes/combat.js (adiciona):

server/skills/service.js

js
const { Pool } = require('pg');
const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL });

async function getHeroMeta(heroId) {
  // classe vem do heroes_master.class via heroKey
  const sql = `
    SELECT ph.id AS hero_id,
           hm.class AS class,
           ph."heroKey" AS hero_key
      FROM player_heroes ph
 LEFT JOIN heroes_master hm ON hm."heroKey" = ph."heroKey"
     WHERE ph.id = $1
     LIMIT 1
  `;
  const { rows } = await pool.query(sql, [heroId]);
  return rows[0] || null;
}

async function resolveSkillTypeFromWeapon(weaponType) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT skill_type FROM weapon_skill_map WHERE weapon_type = $1 LIMIT 1`,
    [weaponType]
  );
  return rows[0]?.skill_type || null;
}

async function getClassRate(_class, skillType) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT rate FROM class_skill_rates WHERE class = $1 AND skill_type = $2 LIMIT 1`,
    [_class || 'KNIGHT', skillType]
  );
  return rows[0]?.rate ?? 1.0;
}

async function getOrCreateHeroSkill(client, heroId, skillType) {
  let { rows } = await client.query(
    `SELECT hero_id, skill_type, level, tries_progress
       FROM player_hero_skills
      WHERE hero_id=$1 AND skill_type=$2
      LIMIT 1`,
    [heroId, skillType]
  );
  if (rows[0]) return rows[0];

  await client.query(
    `INSERT INTO player_hero_skills (hero_id, skill_type, level, tries_progress)
     VALUES ($1, $2, 1, 0)
     ON CONFLICT (hero_id, skill_type) DO NOTHING`,
    [heroId, skillType]
  );
  ({ rows } = await client.query(
    `SELECT hero_id, skill_type, level, tries_progress
       FROM player_hero_skills
      WHERE hero_id=$1 AND skill_type=$2
      LIMIT 1`,
    [heroId, skillType]
  ));
  return rows[0];
}

async function getTriesNeeded(skillType, nextLevel) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT tries_needed FROM skill_curves WHERE skill_type=$1 AND level=$2 LIMIT 1`,
    [skillType, nextLevel]
  );
  return rows[0]?.tries_needed ?? 999999;
}

async function gainSkillTry(heroId, weaponType, opts = {}) {
  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    const hero = await getHeroMeta(heroId);
    if (!hero) throw new Error('Hero not found');

    const skillType = await resolveSkillTypeFromWeapon(weaponType);
    if (!skillType) { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); return { ok:false, message:`No skill for ${weaponType}` }; }

    const rate = await getClassRate(hero.class, skillType);
    const delta = Math.max(1, Math.round((opts.baseTry || 1) * rate));

    let phs = await getOrCreateHeroSkill(client, heroId, skillType);
    let currLevel = phs.level;
    let currTries = Number(phs.tries_progress) + delta;

    while (true) {
      const needed = await getTriesNeeded(skillType, currLevel + 1);
      if (currTries >= needed) {
        currLevel += 1;
        currTries -= needed;
      } else break;
    }

    await client.query(
      `UPDATE player_hero_skills
          SET level=$3, tries_progress=$4
        WHERE hero_id=$1 AND skill_type=$2`,
      [heroId, skillType, currLevel, currTries]
    );

    await client.query('COMMIT');
    return { ok:true, heroId, skillType, level:currLevel, tries_progress:currTries, rate };
  } catch (e) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    return { ok:false, message:e.message };
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

module.exports = { gainSkillTry };

Node — dano + HP de instância (usando o teu schema real)

server/combat/service.js

js
const { Pool } = require('pg');
const { gainSkillTry } = require('../skills/service');
const { addXp } = require('../progression/service'); // Fase de progressão
const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL });

async function getHeroStats(heroId) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT id AS hero_id,
            COALESCE(attack,10)  AS attack,
            COALESCE(defense,10) AS defense
       FROM player_heroes
      WHERE id=$1
      LIMIT 1`,
    [heroId]
  );
  return rows[0] || null;
}

// Busca instância + XP do template. Defesa do monstro: fallback 6 (não há coluna 'defense').
async function getMonsterInstance(client, instanceId) {
  const { rows } = await client.query(
    `SELECT mi.id, mi.hp, mi.max_hp, mi.state,
            m.id AS monster_id, m.name,
            COALESCE(m.xp, 25) AS xp_reward
       FROM monster_instances mi
       JOIN monsters_master m ON m.id = mi.monster_id
      WHERE mi.id = $1
      LIMIT 1`,
    [instanceId]
  );
  return rows[0] || null;
}

function computeDamage(baseAtk, fallbackDef = 6, opts={}) {
  const variance = opts.variance ?? 0.2;
  const raw = Math.max(0, baseAtk - fallbackDef / 2);
  const roll = raw * (1 - variance + Math.random() * (2 * variance));
  return Math.max(0, Math.floor(roll));
}

async function applyHit({ attackerHeroId, targetInstanceId, weaponType }) {
  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    const attacker = await getHeroStats(attackerHeroId);
    const inst = await getMonsterInstance(client, targetInstanceId);
    if (!attacker || !inst) throw new Error('Attacker or monster instance not found');
    if (inst.state !== 'ALIVE') { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); return { ok:false, message:'Target not alive' }; }

    const dmg = computeDamage(attacker.attack, /*def*/6, { variance:0.2 });

    let newHp = inst.hp;
    let killed = false;

    if (dmg > 0) {
      newHp = Math.max(0, inst.hp - dmg);
      killed = newHp === 0;

      await client.query(
        `UPDATE monster_instances
            SET hp=$2,
                state=CASE WHEN $2=0 THEN 'DEAD' ELSE state END,
                updated_at=now()
          WHERE id=$1`,
        [inst.id, newHp]
      );

      await gainSkillTry(attackerHeroId, weaponType, { baseTry:1 });
    }

    await client.query('COMMIT');

    if (killed) {
      await addXp(attackerHeroId, inst.xp_reward); // usa monsters_master.xp
    }

    return { ok:true, damage:dmg, hpAfter:newHp, dead:killed, instanceId:inst.id };
  } catch (e) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    return { ok:false, message:e.message };
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

module.exports = { applyHit };

Obs. quando você padronizar a defesa nos JSONs, dá para ler COALESCE((m."defensesJSON"->>'defense')::int, 6).

-- 010_skills_seed.pg.sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS skill_curves (
  skill_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  level INTEGER NOT NULL,
  tries_needed INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (skill_type, level)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS class_skill_rates (
  class TEXT NOT NULL,
  skill_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  rate NUMERIC(6,3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,
  PRIMARY KEY (class, skill_type)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS weapon_skill_map (
  weapon_type TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  skill_type  TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_skill_curves_skill ON skill_curves (skill_type, level);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_class_skill_rates_class ON class_skill_rates (class, skill_type);

WITH levels AS (SELECT generate_series(1,120) AS lvl)
INSERT INTO skill_curves (skill_type, level, tries_needed)
SELECT s.skill_type, l.lvl, CEIL(8 * POWER(1.175, l.lvl - 1))::int
FROM (VALUES ('SWORD'),('AXE'),('CLUB'),('DISTANCE'),('SHIELD'),('MAGIC')) s(skill_type)
CROSS JOIN levels l
ON CONFLICT (skill_type, level) DO UPDATE
SET tries_needed = EXCLUDED.tries_needed
WHERE skill_curves.tries_needed IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.tries_needed;

DELETE FROM class_skill_rates WHERE class IN ('KNIGHT','RANGER','MAGE','GUARDIAN');

INSERT INTO class_skill_rates (class, skill_type, rate) VALUES
 ('KNIGHT','SWORD',1.200), ('KNIGHT','AXE',1.200), ('KNIGHT','CLUB',1.150), ('KNIGHT','DISTANCE',0.500), ('KNIGHT','SHIELD',1.300), ('KNIGHT','MAGIC',0.200),
 ('RANGER','SWORD',0.600), ('RANGER','AXE',0.600), ('RANGER','CLUB',0.600), ('RANGER','DISTANCE',1.300), ('RANGER','SHIELD',0.800), ('RANGER','MAGIC',0.600),
 ('MAGE','SWORD',0.300),   ('MAGE','AXE',0.300),   ('MAGE','CLUB',0.500),   ('MAGE','DISTANCE',0.700),   ('MAGE','SHIELD',0.500),   ('MAGE','MAGIC',1.400),
 ('GUARDIAN','SWORD',1.000),('GUARDIAN','AXE',0.900),('GUARDIAN','CLUB',0.900),('GUARDIAN','DISTANCE',0.500),('GUARDIAN','SHIELD',1.500),('GUARDIAN','MAGIC',0.400)
ON CONFLICT (class, skill_type) DO UPDATE SET rate=EXCLUDED.rate;

 'sword','longsword','rapier','sabre','dagger',

 'club','mace','hammer','staff',

3) SQL — Progressão (XP/HP/Mana/Level) (020)

Arquivo: server/db/seeds/020_progression.pg.sql

sql
-- 020_progression.pg.sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS xp_curves (
  level INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  xp_to_next INTEGER NOT NULL
);
WITH levels AS (SELECT generate_series(1,200) AS lvl)
INSERT INTO xp_curves (level, xp_to_next)
SELECT lvl, (25 * (lvl * lvl))::int FROM levels
ON CONFLICT (level) DO UPDATE
SET xp_to_next = EXCLUDED.xp_to_next
WHERE xp_curves.xp_to_next IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.xp_to_next;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS class_level_gains (
  class TEXT NOT NULL,
  level INTEGER NOT NULL,
  hp_gain INTEGER NOT NULL,
  mana_gain INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (class, level)
);

WITH lvls AS (SELECT generate_series(2,200) AS lvl)
INSERT INTO class_level_gains (class, level, hp_gain, mana_gain)
SELECT 'KNIGHT', lvl, 20, 3 FROM lvls
ON CONFLICT (class, level) DO UPDATE SET hp_gain=EXCLUDED.hp_gain, mana_gain=EXCLUDED.mana_gain;

WITH lvls AS (SELECT generate_series(2,200) AS lvl)
INSERT INTO class_level_gains (class, level, hp_gain, mana_gain)
SELECT 'RANGER', lvl, 13, 7 FROM lvls
ON CONFLICT (class, level) DO UPDATE SET hp_gain=EXCLUDED.hp_gain, mana_gain=EXCLUDED.mana_gain;

WITH lvls AS (SELECT generate_series(2,200) AS lvl)
INSERT INTO class_level_gains (class, level, hp_gain, mana_gain)
SELECT 'MAGE', lvl, 8, 12 FROM lvls
ON CONFLICT (class, level) DO UPDATE SET hp_gain=EXCLUDED.hp_gain, mana_gain=EXCLUDED.mana_gain;

WITH lvls AS (SELECT generate_series(2,200) AS lvl)
INSERT INTO class_level_gains (class, level, hp_gain, mana_gain)
SELECT 'GUARDIAN', lvl, 24, 2 FROM lvls
ON CONFLICT (class, level) DO UPDATE SET hp_gain=EXCLUDED.hp_gain, mana_gain=EXCLUDED.mana_gain;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hero_progress (
  hero_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  xp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  hp_max INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 150,
  mana_max INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30,
  hp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 150,
  mana INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30,
  class TEXT,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_hero_progress_class ON hero_progress (class);

 ('RANGER','spark'),
 ('KNIGHT','spark'),
 ('GUARDIAN','spark')
ON CONFLICT (class, spell_id) DO NOTHING;

5) SQL — Instância de Monstro (HP em runtime)

Arquivo único (rodar uma vez):

sql
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS monster_instances (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  monster_id INTEGER NOT NULL,   -- monsters_master.id
  map_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  spawn_id INTEGER,
  max_hp INTEGER NOT NULL,
  hp INTEGER NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ALIVE', -- ALIVE|DEAD|DESPAWNED
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_monster_instances_alive
  ON monster_instances (state, map_key);

Na hora do spawn, crie a instância com max_hp = COALESCE(monsters_master."healthMax", monsters_master."healthmax", 50) e hp = max_hp.

6) Runner para rodar SQL (Node)

Arquivo: server/scripts/pg-run-sql.js

js
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { Pool } = require('pg');

if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) {
  console.error('❌ DATABASE_URL não definido.');
  process.exit(1);
}
const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL, max: 2 });

async function runFile(file) {
  const sql = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
  console.log(`\n▶ ${file}`);
  await pool.query(sql);
  console.log(`✔ OK ${path.basename(file)}`);
}

(async () => {
  try {
    const target = process.argv[2];
    if (!target) { console.error('Uso: node scripts/pg-run-sql.js <arquivo.sql|pasta>'); process.exit(1); }
    const stat = fs.statSync(target);
    if (stat.isDirectory()) {
      const files = fs.readdirSync(target)
        .filter(f => f.toLowerCase().endsWith('.sql'))
        .sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,undefined,{numeric:true}))
        .map(f=>path.join(target,f));
      for (const f of files) await runFile(f);
    } else {
      await runFile(target);
    }
    await pool.end();
    console.log('\n✅ Concluído.');
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('❌ Erro:', e.message);
    process.exit(1);
  }
})();

8) Service — Skills (tries_progress)

Arquivo: server/skills/service.js

js
const { Pool } = require('pg');
const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL });

async function getHeroMeta(heroId) {
  const sql = `
    SELECT ph.id AS hero_id,
           hm.class AS class,
           ph."heroKey" AS hero_key
      FROM player_heroes ph
 LEFT JOIN heroes_master hm ON hm."heroKey" = ph."heroKey"
     WHERE ph.id = $1
     LIMIT 1
  `;
  const { rows } = await pool.query(sql, [heroId]);
  return rows[0] || null;
}

async function resolveSkillTypeFromWeapon(weaponType) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT skill_type FROM weapon_skill_map WHERE weapon_type=$1 LIMIT 1`,
    [weaponType]
  );
  return rows[0]?.skill_type || null;
}

async function getClassRate(_class, skillType) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT rate FROM class_skill_rates WHERE class=$1 AND skill_type=$2 LIMIT 1`,
    [_class || 'KNIGHT', skillType]
  );
  return rows[0]?.rate ?? 1.0;
}

async function getOrCreateHeroSkill(client, heroId, skillType) {
  let { rows } = await client.query(
    `SELECT hero_id, skill_type, level, tries_progress
       FROM player_hero_skills
      WHERE hero_id=$1 AND skill_type=$2 LIMIT 1`,
    [heroId, skillType]
  );
  if (rows[0]) return rows[0];

  await client.query(
    `INSERT INTO player_hero_skills (hero_id, skill_type, level, tries_progress)
     VALUES ($1,$2,1,0)
     ON CONFLICT (hero_id, skill_type) DO NOTHING`,
    [heroId, skillType]
  );
  ({ rows } = await client.query(
    `SELECT hero_id, skill_type, level, tries_progress
       FROM player_hero_skills
      WHERE hero_id=$1 AND skill_type=$2 LIMIT 1`,
    [heroId, skillType]
  ));
  return rows[0];
}

async function getTriesNeeded(skillType, nextLevel) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT tries_needed FROM skill_curves WHERE skill_type=$1 AND level=$2 LIMIT 1`,
    [skillType, nextLevel]
  );
  return rows[0]?.tries_needed ?? 999999;
}

async function gainSkillTry(heroId, weaponType, opts = {}) {
  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    const hero = await getHeroMeta(heroId);
    if (!hero) throw new Error('Hero not found');

    const skillType = await resolveSkillTypeFromWeapon(weaponType);
    if (!skillType) { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); return { ok:false, message:`No skill for ${weaponType}` }; }

    const rate = await getClassRate(hero.class, skillType);
    const delta = Math.max(1, Math.round((opts.baseTry || 1) * rate));

    let phs = await getOrCreateHeroSkill(client, heroId, skillType);
    let currLevel = phs.level;
    let currTries = Number(phs.tries_progress) + delta;

    while (true) {
      const needed = await getTriesNeeded(skillType, currLevel + 1);
      if (currTries >= needed) {
        currLevel += 1;
        currTries -= needed;
      } else break;
    }

    await client.query(
      `UPDATE player_hero_skills
          SET level=$3, tries_progress=$4
        WHERE hero_id=$1 AND skill_type=$2`,
      [heroId, skillType, currLevel, currTries]
    );

    await client.query('COMMIT');
    return { ok:true, heroId, skillType, level:currLevel, tries_progress:currTries, rate };
  } catch (e) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    return { ok:false, message:e.message };
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

module.exports = { gainSkillTry };

9) Service — Progressão (XP/Level; HP/Mana por classe)

Arquivo: server/progression/service.js

js
const { Pool } = require('pg');
const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL });

async function getHeroClass(heroId) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT hm.class
       FROM player_heroes ph
  LEFT JOIN heroes_master hm ON hm."heroKey" = ph."heroKey"
      WHERE ph.id=$1 LIMIT 1`,
    [heroId]
  );
  return rows[0]?.class || 'KNIGHT';
}

async function ensureHeroProgress(heroId) {
  const _class = await getHeroClass(heroId);
  await pool.query(
    `INSERT INTO hero_progress (hero_id, class)
     VALUES ($1,$2)
     ON CONFLICT (hero_id) DO NOTHING`,
    [heroId, _class]
  );
}

async function computeMaxStats(_class, level) {
  let baseHp = 150, baseMana = 30;
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT COALESCE(SUM(hp_gain),0) AS hp_sum,
            COALESCE(SUM(mana_gain),0) AS mana_sum
       FROM class_level_gains
      WHERE class=$1 AND level <= $2`,
    [_class, level]
  );
  const hpMax = baseHp + Number(rows[0].hp_sum || 0);
  const manaMax = baseMana + Number(rows[0].mana_sum || 0);
  return { hpMax, manaMax };
}

async function xpToNext(level) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT xp_to_next FROM xp_curves WHERE level=$1 LIMIT 1`, [level]
  );
  return rows[0]?.xp_to_next || 9999999;
}

async function addXp(heroId, amount) {
  await ensureHeroProgress(heroId);
  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    let { rows } = await client.query(
      `SELECT hero_id, level, xp, class, hp, mana, hp_max, mana_max
         FROM hero_progress WHERE hero_id=$1 LIMIT 1`,
      [heroId]
    );
    if (!rows[0]) throw new Error('hero_progress not found');
    let { level, xp, class: _class } = rows[0];

    xp += amount;
    let leveled = false;

    while (true) {
      const need = await xpToNext(level);
      if (xp >= need) { xp -= need; level += 1; leveled = true; }
      else break;
    }

    const { hpMax, manaMax } = await computeMaxStats(_class, level);

    await client.query(
      `UPDATE hero_progress
          SET level=$2, xp=$3, hp_max=$4, mana_max=$5,
              hp = CASE WHEN $6 THEN $4 ELSE LEAST(hp,$4) END,
              mana = CASE WHEN $6 THEN $5 ELSE LEAST(mana,$5) END,
              updated_at=now()
        WHERE hero_id=$1`,
      [heroId, level, xp, hpMax, manaMax, leveled]
    );

    await client.query('COMMIT');
    return { ok:true, level, xp, hpMax, manaMax, class:_class, leveled };
  } catch (e) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    return { ok:false, message:e.message };
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

module.exports = { addXp, computeMaxStats, xpToNext, ensureHeroProgress };

10) Service — Combate (hit → dano + HP cai + XP se morrer)

Arquivo: server/combat/service.js

js
const { Pool } = require('pg');
const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL });
const { gainSkillTry } = require('../skills/service');
const { addXp } = require('../progression/service');

async function getHeroStats(heroId) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT id AS hero_id,
            COALESCE(attack,10) AS attack,
            COALESCE(defense,10) AS defense
       FROM player_heroes
      WHERE id=$1 LIMIT 1`,
    [heroId]
  );
  return rows[0] || null;
}

async function getMonsterInstance(client, instanceId) {
  const { rows } = await client.query(
    `SELECT mi.id, mi.hp, mi.max_hp, mi.state,
            m.id AS monster_id, m.name,
            COALESCE(m.xp,25) AS xp_reward
       FROM monster_instances mi
       JOIN monsters_master m ON m.id = mi.monster_id
      WHERE mi.id=$1 LIMIT 1`,
    [instanceId]
  );
  return rows[0] || null;
}

function computeDamage(baseAtk, fallbackDef = 6, opts={}) {
  const variance = opts.variance ?? 0.2;
  const raw = Math.max(0, baseAtk - fallbackDef/2);
  const roll = raw * (1 - variance + Math.random()*(2*variance));
  return Math.max(0, Math.floor(roll));
}

async function applyHit({ attackerHeroId, targetInstanceId, weaponType }) {
  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    const attacker = await getHeroStats(attackerHeroId);
    const inst = await getMonsterInstance(client, targetInstanceId);
    if (!attacker || !inst) throw new Error('Attacker or monster instance not found');
    if (inst.state !== 'ALIVE') { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); return { ok:false, message:'Target not alive' }; }

    const dmg = computeDamage(attacker.attack, 6, { variance:0.2 });

    let newHp = inst.hp, killed = false;
    if (dmg > 0) {
      newHp = Math.max(0, inst.hp - dmg);
      killed = newHp === 0;

      await client.query(
        `UPDATE monster_instances
            SET hp=$2, state=CASE WHEN $2=0 THEN 'DEAD' ELSE state END, updated_at=now()
          WHERE id=$1`,
        [inst.id, newHp]
      );

      await gainSkillTry(attackerHeroId, weaponType, { baseTry:1 });
    }

    await client.query('COMMIT');

    if (killed) { await addXp(attackerHeroId, inst.xp_reward); }

    return { ok:true, damage:dmg, hpAfter:newHp, dead:killed, instanceId:inst.id };
  } catch (e) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    return { ok:false, message:e.message };
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

module.exports = { applyHit };

11) Service — Magia (cast com mana + ML)

Arquivo: server/combat/spell_service.js

js
const { Pool } = require('pg');
const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL });
const { gainSkillTry } = require('../skills/service');

async function getMagicLevel(heroId) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT level FROM player_hero_skills WHERE hero_id=$1 AND skill_type='MAGIC'`,
    [heroId]
  );
  return rows[0]?.level || 1;
}
async function getMana(heroId) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT mana, mana_max FROM hero_progress WHERE hero_id=$1`, [heroId]
  );
  return rows[0] || { mana:0, mana_max:0 };
}
async function spendMana(heroId, cost) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `UPDATE hero_progress
        SET mana = GREATEST(0, mana - $2), updated_at=now()
      WHERE hero_id=$1 AND mana >= $2
      RETURNING mana, mana_max`,
    [heroId, cost]
  );
  return !!rows[0];
}
async function getSpell(spellId) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT * FROM spells_master WHERE id=$1`, [spellId]
  );
  return rows[0] || null;
}
async function canUseSpell(_class, spellId) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT 1 FROM class_spells WHERE class=$1 AND spell_id=$2`, [_class, spellId]
  );
  return !!rows[0];
}
async function getHeroClass(heroId) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT hm.class
       FROM player_heroes ph
  LEFT JOIN heroes_master hm ON hm."heroKey" = ph."heroKey"
      WHERE ph.id=$1 LIMIT 1`, [heroId]
  );
  return rows[0]?.class || 'KNIGHT';
}

async function castSpellOnInstance({ casterHeroId, targetInstanceId, spellId }) {
  const spell = await getSpell(spellId);
  if (!spell) return { ok:false, message:'Spell not found' };

  const _class = await getHeroClass(casterHeroId);
  const allowed = await canUseSpell(_class, spellId);
  if (!allowed) return { ok:false, message:'spell locked for class' };

  const ml = await getMagicLevel(casterHeroId);
  if (ml < spell.min_magic_level) return { ok:false, message:'insufficient magic level' };

  const manaState = await getMana(casterHeroId);
  if (manaState.mana < spell.mana_cost) return { ok:false, message:'not enough mana' };

  const dmg = Math.max(0, Math.floor(spell.base_power + (ml * Number(spell.scaling || 1))));

  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');
    const { rows: instRows } = await client.query(
      `SELECT mi.id, mi.hp, mi.max_hp, mi.state
         FROM monster_instances mi
        WHERE mi.id=$1 LIMIT 1`, [targetInstanceId]
    );
    const inst = instRows[0];
    if (!inst) { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); return { ok:false, message:'Monster instance not found' }; }
    if (inst.state !== 'ALIVE') { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); return { ok:false, message:'Target not alive' }; }

    const okay = await spendMana(casterHeroId, spell.mana_cost);
    if (!okay) { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); return { ok:false, message:'not enough mana' }; }

    const newHp = Math.max(0, inst.hp - dmg);
    const dead = newHp === 0;
    await client.query(
      `UPDATE monster_instances
          SET hp=$2, state=CASE WHEN $2=0 THEN 'DEAD' ELSE state END, updated_at=now()
        WHERE id=$1`,
      [inst.id, newHp]
    );

    await client.query('COMMIT');

    // MAGIC sobe por cast (usa mapping 'wand'->MAGIC)
    await gainSkillTry(casterHeroId, 'wand', { baseTry:1 });

    return { ok:true, damage:dmg, hpAfter:newHp, dead, instanceId:inst.id };
  } catch (e) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    return { ok:false, message:e.message };
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

module.exports = { castSpellOnInstance };

Vou no passo-a-passo, bem calmo, e sem depender de monsterKey.

1) Ver o que realmente existe (sem quebrar)

Roda estes dois comandos para listar as colunas reais:

sql
-- Quais colunas existem em monsters_master?
SELECT column_name, data_type
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='monsters_master'
ORDER BY ordinal_position;

-- Idem para as outras tabelas que usamos

FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema='public'

Isso te mostra exatamente os nomes (ex.: healthMax ou healthmax ou hp).

Mas… pra não te travar agora, abaixo já vai um SQL “blindado” que funciona mesmo sem saber o nome exato das colunas de HP/XP.

2) Spawn de instância sem depender de nomes (usa to_jsonb)

O truque: to_jsonb(m) transforma a linha inteira em JSON; daí a gente tenta várias chaves comuns (healthMax, healthmax, max_hp, hp, etc.) sem dar erro se não existir.

2.1 Criar UMA instância para teste

sql
-- Troque o ID do monstro na cláusula WHERE (use um que exista)
INSERT INTO monster_instances (monster_id, map_key, max_hp, hp)
SELECT m.id,
       'house' AS map_key,
       COALESCE(
         (to_jsonb(m)->>'healthMax')::int,
         (to_jsonb(m)->>'healthmax')::int,
         (to_jsonb(m)->>'max_hp')::int,
         (to_jsonb(m)->>'hp_max')::int,
         (to_jsonb(m)->>'hp')::int,
         50
       ) AS max_hp,
       COALESCE(
         (to_jsonb(m)->>'healthMax')::int,
         (to_jsonb(m)->>'healthmax')::int,
         (to_jsonb(m)->>'max_hp')::int,
         (to_jsonb(m)->>'hp_max')::int,
         (to_jsonb(m)->>'hp')::int,
         50
       ) AS hp
FROM monsters_master m
WHERE m.id = 1   -- <<< troque para um id que exista
RETURNING id, monster_id, hp, max_hp, state;

Diferente do SELECT que quebrou, esse não usa monsterKey.
Mesmo que o nome seja healthMax ou hp, ele pega o valor sem erro.

2.2 Conferir se nasceu

sql

FROM monster_instances
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 5;

Se vier 0 linhas, é porque m.id do WHERE não existe — troca o id e repete.

3) Ajuste “blindado” no serviço de combate (XP do monstro)

No código do getMonsterInstance (no server/combat/service.js), troque a leitura do XP para não depender de nome exato:

js
// dentro do SELECT ...
COALESCE( (to_jsonb(m)->>'xp')::int, 25 ) AS xp_reward

Fica assim:

js
async function getMonsterInstance(client, instanceId) {
  const { rows } = await client.query(
    `SELECT mi.id, mi.hp, mi.max_hp, mi.state,
            m.id AS monster_id, m.name,
            COALESCE( (to_jsonb(m)->>'xp')::int, 25 ) AS xp_reward
       FROM monster_instances mi
       JOIN monsters_master m ON m.id = mi.monster_id
      WHERE mi.id = $1
      LIMIT 1`,
    [instanceId]
  );
  return rows[0] || null;
}

Isso te blinda caso o campo seja xp ou venha dentro de algum JSON futuro.

4) Teste do hit (o resto continua igual)

Com a instância criada:

bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/combat/hit ^
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" ^
  -d "{\"attackerHeroId\":\"<HERO_ID>\",\"targetInstanceId\":\"<INSTANCE_UUID>\",\"weaponType\":\"sword\"}"

  • Esperado: { ok:true, damage, hpAfter, dead, instanceId }

  • Depois confere a skill:

sql
SELECT hero_id, skill_type, level, tries_progress
FROM player_hero_skills
WHERE hero_id = '<HERO_ID>';

5) Por que isso resolve o que apareceu nas tuas prints

  • Erro de coluna (monsterKey): resolvido — não usamos mais.

  • HP do monstro: lido via to_jsonb(m) com COALESCE(...) → não interessa se é healthMax ou hp.

  • Nenhuma instância criada: agora o INSERT vai rodar; se continuar 0 linhas é só ajustar o WHERE m.id = … para um id que exista.

  • “Já existia”: sim, tua tabela monster_instances já estava criada (ótimo!) — minha mensagem disse “pulou sem erro”, mas entendo que soou como “inventei”. A partir de agora, vou evitar exemplos com colunas que você talvez não tenha.

6) Se quiser deixar 100% à prova de esquema (opcional)

Você pode até deixar o spawn automático assim (também blindado):

sql
-- cria N instâncias para o primeiro monstro da tabela, só pra teste
WITH base AS (
  SELECT id AS monster_id,
         COALESCE(
           (to_jsonb(m)->>'healthMax')::int,
           (to_jsonb(m)->>'healthmax')::int,
           (to_jsonb(m)->>'max_hp')::int,
           (to_jsonb(m)->>'hp_max')::int,
           (to_jsonb(m)->>'hp')::int,
           50
         ) AS max_hp
  FROM monsters_master m
  ORDER BY id
  LIMIT 1
)
INSERT INTO monster_instances (monster_id, map_key, max_hp, hp)
SELECT b.monster_id, 'house', b.max_hp, b.max_hp
FROM base b
RETURNING id, monster_id, hp, max_hp, state;

7) Resumo honesto

  • Eu te passei um SELECT com monsterKey que não existe na tua tabela — isso gerou erro e frustração. Foi minha.

  • Corrigi o fluxo para não depender desses nomes; o uso de to_jsonb + COALESCE evita esses “estouros de coluna”.

  • Agora você consegue spawnear, dar hit, ver HP cair, skill subir e, ao matar, ganhar XP.

} async function computeMaxStats(_class, level) { let baseHp = 150, baseMana = 30; const { rows } = await pool.query( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(hp_gain),0) AS hp_sum, COALESCE(SUM(mana_gain),0) AS mana_sum FROM class_level_gains WHERE class=$1 AND level <= $2, [_class, level] ); const hpMax = baseHp + Number(rows[0].hp_sum || 0); const manaMax = baseMana + Number(rows[0].mana_sum || 0); return { hpMax, manaMax }; } async function xpToNext(level) { const { rows } = await pool.query( SELECT xp_to_next FROM xp_curves WHERE level=$1 LIMIT 1, [level] ); return rows[0]?.xp_to_next || 9999999; } async function addXp(heroId, amount) { await ensureHeroProgress(heroId); const client = await pool.connect(); try { await client.query('BEGIN'); let { rows } = await client.query( SELECT hero_id, level, xp, class, hp, mana, hp_max, mana_max FROM hero_progress WHERE hero_id=$1 LIMIT 1, [heroId] ); if (!rows[0]) throw new Error('hero_progress not found'); let { level, xp, class: _class } = rows[0]; xp += amount; let leveled = false; while (true) { const need = await xpToNext(level); if (xp >= need) { xp -= need; level += 1; leveled = true; } else break; } const { hpMax, manaMax } = await computeMaxStats(_class, level); await client.query( UPDATE hero_progress SET level=$2, xp=$3, hp_max=$4, mana_max=$5, hp = CASE WHEN $6 THEN $4 ELSE LEAST(hp,$4) END, mana = CASE WHEN $6 THEN $5 ELSE LEAST(mana,$5) END, updated_at=now() WHERE hero_id=$1, [heroId, level, xp, hpMax, manaMax, leveled] ); await client.query('COMMIT'); return { ok:true, level, xp, hpMax, manaMax, class:_class, leveled }; } catch (e) { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); return { ok:false, message:e.message }; } finally { client.release(); } } module.exports = { addXp, computeMaxStats, xpToNext, ensureHeroProgress }; 10) Service — Combate (hit → dano + HP cai + XP se morrer) Arquivo: server/combat/service.js const { Pool } = require('pg'); const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL }); const { gainSkillTry } = require('../skills/service'); const { addXp } = require('../progression/service'); async function getHeroStats(heroId) { const { rows } = await pool.query( SELECT id AS hero_id, COALESCE(attack,10) AS attack, COALESCE(defense,10) AS defense FROM player_heroes WHERE id=$1 LIMIT 1, [heroId] ); return rows[0] || null; } async function getMonsterInstance(client, instanceId) { const { rows } = await client.query( SELECT mi.id, mi.hp, mi.max_hp, mi.state, m.id AS monster_id, m.name, COALESCE(m.xp,25) AS xp_reward FROM monster_instances mi JOIN monsters_master m ON m.id = mi.monster_id WHERE mi.id=$1 LIMIT 1, [instanceId] ); return rows[0] || null; } function computeDamage(baseAtk, fallbackDef = 6, opts={}) { const variance = opts.variance ?? 0.2; const raw = Math.max(0, baseAtk - fallbackDef/2); const roll = raw * (1 - variance + Math.random()*(2*variance)); return Math.max(0, Math.floor(roll)); } async function applyHit({ attackerHeroId, targetInstanceId, weaponType }) { const client = await pool.connect(); try { await client.query('BEGIN'); const attacker = await getHeroStats(attackerHeroId); const inst = await getMonsterInstance(client, targetInstanceId); if (!attacker || !inst) throw new Error('Attacker or monster instance not found'); if (inst.state !== 'ALIVE') { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); return { ok:false, message:'Target not alive' }; } const dmg = computeDamage(attacker.attack, 6, { variance:0.2 }); let newHp = inst.hp, killed = false; if (dmg > 0) { newHp = Math.max(0, inst.hp - dmg); killed = newHp === 0; await client.query( UPDATE monster_instances SET hp=$2, state=CASE WHEN $2=0 THEN 'DEAD' ELSE state END, updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1, [inst.id, newHp] ); await gainSkillTry(attackerHeroId, weaponType, { baseTry:1 }); } await client.query('COMMIT'); if (killed) { await addXp(attackerHeroId, inst.xp_reward); } return { ok:true, damage:dmg, hpAfter:newHp, dead:killed, instanceId:inst.id }; } catch (e) { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); return { ok:false, message:e.message }; } finally { client.release(); } } module.exports = { applyHit }; 11) Service — Magia (cast com mana + ML) Arquivo: server/combat/spell_service.js const { Pool } = require('pg'); const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL }); const { gainSkillTry } = require('../skills/service'); async function getMagicLevel(heroId) { const { rows } = await pool.query( SELECT level FROM player_hero_skills WHERE hero_id=$1 AND skill_type='MAGIC', [heroId] ); return rows[0]?.level || 1; } async function getMana(heroId) { const { rows } = await pool.query( SELECT mana, mana_max FROM hero_progress WHERE hero_id=$1, [heroId] ); return rows[0] || { mana:0, mana_max:0 }; } async function spendMana(heroId, cost) { const { rows } = await pool.query( UPDATE hero_progress SET mana = GREATEST(0, mana - $2), updated_at=now() WHERE hero_id=$1 AND mana >= $2 RETURNING mana, mana_max, [heroId, cost] ); return !!rows[0]; } async function getSpell(spellId) { const { rows } = await pool.query( SELECT * FROM spells_master WHERE id=$1, [spellId] ); return rows[0] || null; } async function canUseSpell(_class, spellId) { const { rows } = await pool.query( SELECT 1 FROM class_spells WHERE class=$1 AND spell_id=$2, [_class, spellId] ); return !!rows[0]; } async function getHeroClass(heroId) { const { rows } = await pool.query( SELECT hm.class FROM player_heroes ph LEFT JOIN heroes_master hm ON hm."heroKey" = ph."heroKey" WHERE ph.id=$1 LIMIT 1, [heroId] ); const _class = await getHeroClass(casterHeroId); const allowed = await canUseSpell(_class, spellId); if (!allowed) return { ok:false, message:'spell locked for class' }; const ml = await getMagicLevel(casterHeroId); if (ml < spell.min_magic_level) return { ok:false, message:'insufficient magic level' }; const manaState = await getMana(casterHeroId); if (manaState.mana < spell.mana_cost) return { ok:false, message:'not enough mana' }; const inst = instRows[0]; if (!inst) { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); return { ok:false, message:'Monster instance not found' }; } if (inst.state !== 'ALIVE') { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); return { ok:false, message:'Target not alive' }; } const okay = await spendMana(casterHeroId, spell.mana_cost); if (!okay) { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); return { ok:false, message:'not enough mana' }; } const newHp = Math.max(0, inst.hp - dmg); const dead = newHp === 0; await client.query( UPDATE monster_instances SET hp=$2, state=CASE WHEN $2=0 THEN 'DEAD' ELSE state END, updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1, [inst.id, newHp] ); await client.query('COMMIT'); return { ok:false, message:e.message }; } finally { client.release(); } } module.exports = { castSpellOnInstance }; 12) Rotas novas Arquivo: server/routes/combat.js const express = require('express'); sql
-- 020_progression.pg.sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS xp_curves (
  level INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  xp_to_next INTEGER NOT NULL
);
WITH levels AS (SELECT generate_series(1,200) AS lvl)
INSERT INTO xp_curves (level, xp_to_next)
SELECT lvl, (25 * (lvl * lvl))::int FROM levels
ON CONFLICT (level) DO UPDATE
SET xp_to_next = EXCLUDED.xp_to_next
WHERE xp_curves.xp_to_next IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.xp_to_next;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS class_level_gains (
  class TEXT NOT NULL,
  level INTEGER NOT NULL,
  hp_gain INTEGER NOT NULL,
  mana_gain INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (class, level)
);

WITH lvls AS (SELECT generate_series(2,200) AS lvl)
INSERT INTO class_level_gains (class, level, hp_gain, mana_gain)
SELECT 'KNIGHT', lvl, 20, 3 FROM lvls
ON CONFLICT (class, level) DO UPDATE SET hp_gain=EXCLUDED.hp_gain, mana_gain=EXCLUDED.mana_gain;

WITH lvls AS (SELECT generate_series(2,200) AS lvl)
INSERT INTO class_level_gains (class, level, hp_gain, mana_gain)
SELECT 'RANGER', lvl, 13, 7 FROM lvls
ON CONFLICT (class, level) DO UPDATE SET hp_gain=EXCLUDED.hp_gain, mana_gain=EXCLUDED.mana_gain;

WITH lvls AS (SELECT generate_series(2,200) AS lvl)
INSERT INTO class_level_gains (class, level, hp_gain, mana_gain)
SELECT 'MAGE',  lvl, 8, 12 FROM lvls
ON CONFLICT (class, level) DO UPDATE SET hp_gain=EXCLUDED.hp_gain, mana_gain=EXCLUDED.mana_gain;

WITH lvls AS (SELECT generate_series(2,200) AS lvl)
INSERT INTO class_level_gains (class, level, hp_gain, mana_gain)
SELECT 'GUARDIAN', lvl, 24, 2 FROM lvls
ON CONFLICT (class, level) DO UPDATE SET hp_gain=EXCLUDED.hp_gain, mana_gain=EXCLUDED.mana_gain;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hero_progress (
  hero_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  xp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  hp_max INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 150,
  mana_max INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30,
  hp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 150,
  mana INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30,
  class TEXT,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_hero_progress_class ON hero_progress (class);

-- 020_progression.pg.sql

-- 1) Curva de XP
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS xp_curves (
  level INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  xp_to_next INTEGER NOT NULL
);

WITH levels AS (SELECT generate_series(1,200) AS lvl)
INSERT INTO xp_curves (level, xp_to_next)
SELECT lvl, (25 * (lvl * lvl))::int
FROM levels
ON CONFLICT (level) DO UPDATE
SET xp_to_next = EXCLUDED.xp_to_next
WHERE xp_curves.xp_to_next IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.xp_to_next;

-- 2) Ganhos por classe/nível

  class TEXT NOT NULL,
  level INTEGER NOT NULL,
  hp_gain INTEGER NOT NULL,
  mana_gain INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (class, level)
);

INSERT INTO class_level_gains (class, level, hp_gain, mana_gain)

ON CONFLICT (class, level) DO UPDATE
SET hp_gain = EXCLUDED.hp_gain,
    mana_gain = EXCLUDED.mana_gain;

INSERT INTO class_level_gains (class, level, hp_gain, mana_gain)

-- skill_curves: níveis 1..120 por skill_type

FROM skill_curves

ORDER BY skill_type;

)

WHERE prev IS NOT NULL AND tries_needed < prev
GROUP BY skill_type;

Seed 010 (parte de curvas e rates)

sql
-- curvas por skill (1..120)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS skill_curves (
  skill_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  level INTEGER NOT NULL,
  tries_needed INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (skill_type, level)
);

-- gera 6 skills x 120 níveis = 720 linhas
WITH levels AS (SELECT generate_series(1,120) AS lvl)
INSERT INTO skill_curves (skill_type, level, tries_needed)
SELECT s.skill_type, l.lvl, CEIL(8 * POWER(1.175, l.lvl - 1))::int
FROM (VALUES ('SWORD'),('AXE'),('CLUB'),('DISTANCE'),('SHIELD'),('MAGIC')) s(skill_type)
CROSS JOIN levels l
ON CONFLICT (skill_type, level) DO UPDATE
SET tries_needed = EXCLUDED.tries_needed
WHERE skill_curves.tries_needed IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.tries_needed;

-- rates por classe x skill
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS class_skill_rates (
  class TEXT NOT NULL,
  skill_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  rate NUMERIC(6,3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,
  PRIMARY KEY (class, skill_type)
);

INSERT INTO class_skill_rates (class, skill_type, rate) VALUES
 ('KNIGHT','SWORD',1.200), ('KNIGHT','AXE',1.200), ('KNIGHT','CLUB',1.150), ('KNIGHT','DISTANCE',0.500), ('KNIGHT','SHIELD',1.300), ('KNIGHT','MAGIC',0.200),
 ('RANGER','SWORD',0.600), ('RANGER','AXE',0.600), ('RANGER','CLUB',0.600), ('RANGER','DISTANCE',1.300), ('RANGER','SHIELD',0.800), ('RANGER','MAGIC',0.600),
 ('MAGE','SWORD',0.300),   ('MAGE','AXE',0.300),   ('MAGE','CLUB',0.500),   ('MAGE','DISTANCE',0.700),   ('MAGE','SHIELD',0.500),   ('MAGE','MAGIC',1.400),
 ('GUARDIAN','SWORD',1.000),('GUARDIAN','AXE',0.900),('GUARDIAN','CLUB',0.900),('GUARDIAN','DISTANCE',0.500),('GUARDIAN','SHIELD',1.500),('GUARDIAN','MAGIC',0.400)
ON CONFLICT (class, skill_type) DO UPDATE
SET rate = EXCLUDED.rate;

FROM skill_curves GROUP BY skill_type ORDER BY skill_type;

Passo 1 — Service de skills (gainSkillTry)

Crie server/skills/service.js:

js
// server/skills/service.js
const { Pool } = require('pg');
const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL });

async function getHeroMeta(heroId) {
  const sql = `
    SELECT ph.id AS hero_id,
           hm.class AS class,
           ph."heroKey" AS hero_key
      FROM player_heroes ph
 LEFT JOIN heroes_master hm ON hm."heroKey" = ph."heroKey"
     WHERE ph.id = $1
     LIMIT 1
  `;
  const { rows } = await pool.query(sql, [heroId]);
  return rows[0] || null;
}

async function resolveSkillTypeFromWeapon(weaponType) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT skill_type FROM weapon_skill_map WHERE weapon_type=$1 LIMIT 1`,
    [weaponType]
  );
  return rows[0]?.skill_type || null;
}

async function getClassRate(_class, skillType) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT rate FROM class_skill_rates WHERE class=$1 AND skill_type=$2 LIMIT 1`,
    [_class || 'KNIGHT', skillType]
  );
  return rows[0]?.rate ?? 1.0;
}

async function getOrCreateHeroSkill(client, heroId, skillType) {
  let { rows } = await client.query(
    `SELECT hero_id, skill_type, level, tries_progress
       FROM player_hero_skills
      WHERE hero_id=$1 AND skill_type=$2 LIMIT 1`,
    [heroId, skillType]
  );
  if (rows[0]) return rows[0];

  await client.query(
    `INSERT INTO player_hero_skills (hero_id, skill_type, level, tries_progress)
     VALUES ($1,$2,1,0)
     ON CONFLICT (hero_id, skill_type) DO NOTHING`,
    [heroId, skillType]
  );
  ({ rows } = await client.query(
    `SELECT hero_id, skill_type, level, tries_progress
       FROM player_hero_skills
      WHERE hero_id=$1 AND skill_type=$2 LIMIT 1`,
    [heroId, skillType]
  ));
  return rows[0];
}

async function getTriesNeeded(skillType, nextLevel) {
  const { rows } = await pool.query(
    `SELECT tries_needed FROM skill_curves WHERE skill_type=$1 AND level=$2 LIMIT 1`,
    [skillType, nextLevel]
  );
  return rows[0]?.tries_needed ?? 999999;
}

async function gainSkillTry(heroId, weaponType, opts = {}) {
  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    const hero = await getHeroMeta(heroId);
    if (!hero) throw new Error('Hero not found');

    const skillType = await resolveSkillTypeFromWeapon(weaponType);
    if (!skillType) { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); return { ok:false, message:`No skill for ${weaponType}` }; }

    const rate = await getClassRate(hero.class, skillType);
    const delta = Math.max(1, Math.round((opts.baseTry || 1) * rate));

    let phs = await getOrCreateHeroSkill(client, heroId, skillType);
    let currLevel = phs.level;
    let currTries = Number(phs.tries_progress) + delta;

    while (true) {
      const needed = await getTriesNeeded(skillType, currLevel + 1);
      if (currTries >= needed) {
        currLevel += 1;
        currTries -= needed;
      } else break;
    }

    await client.query(
      `UPDATE player_hero_skills
          SET level=$3, tries_progress=$4
        WHERE hero_id=$1 AND skill_type=$2`,
      [heroId, skillType, currLevel, currTries]
    );

    await client.query('COMMIT');
    return { ok:true, heroId, skillType, level:currLevel, tries_progress:currTries, rate };
  } catch (e) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    return { ok:false, message:e.message };
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

module.exports = { gainSkillTry };
